scripts.bundle:ios: pnpm --filter @hamster-note/native-reader-demo exec expo export --platform ios --output-dir dist-ios-smoke
scripts.bundle:android: pnpm --filter @hamster-note/native-reader-demo exec expo export --platform android --output-dir dist-android-smoke
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @hamster-note/native-reader run typecheck && pnpm --filter @hamster-note/native-reader-demo run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm -w exec eslint . --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern && pnpm --filter @hamster-note/native-reader run lint && pnpm --filter @hamster-note/native-reader-demo run lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @hamster-note/native-reader run test && pnpm --filter @hamster-note/native-reader-demo run test
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hamster-note/native-reader run build:verify && pnpm --filter @hamster-note/native-reader-demo run build:web
scripts.verify: pnpm run fixtures:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
